remarks: Spacious Colonial with 4 bedrooms and 4 full bathrooms in a prime location close to town. Perfect for entertaining with a large dining room and a living room to match featuring a wood-burning stove and bay window. The Primary Bedroom boasts a fireplace and a newly tiled ensuite bath with a jacuzzi tub and shower. Enjoy the elegance of hardwood floors throughout and the fresh look of newly painted interiors. The main floor also offers a family room, while the lower level includes a playroom, an office (or guest space), and a full bathroom. Step outside to a nice backyard and park with ease in the 2-car detached garage.
